up: Retrieve the first 1000 rows of IC50 activity data with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1293224 (Microtubule-associated protein tau). Only include activities with standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. For each activity, provide: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target_type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard_type (from activities.standard_type), and pchembl_value (from activities.pchembl_value). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       a.standard_type,
       a.pchembl_value
FROM target_dictionary td
JOIN assays ass ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN activities a ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = a.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293224'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
